fusions.name: Horn-First
fusions.desc: A head-down gore that deals 14 damage, leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and knocks it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Ledge-Clearing Toss
fusions.desc: Tosses your head through a cone ahead of you, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Sure Purchase
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

fusions.name: Butt Back
fusions.desc: When you take damage from anything but fire, your physical damage rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
